slides.title: Choose Your Aesthetic Direction
slides.context: Four distinct visual approaches. Each preserves your core content (Tesla experience, projects, education) but reimagines the visual personality.

options.label: Cyber-Terminal
options.description: Retro-futuristic terminal aesthetic with phosphor greens and monospace dominance
options.aside:
Inspired by CRT monitors, hacker culture, and vintage computing.

• Phosphor green (#7ee787) on deep black (#0a0c0a)
• Departure Mono for everything — maximalist monospace
• Scanlines, subtle CRT flicker, block cursors
• ASCII borders and box-drawing characters
• Raw rectangular photo treatment, no rounded corners
• Glitch hover effects on links

Best if you want to lean into your embedded systems/robotics edge and stand out from typical 'clean' portfolios.

options.label: Liquid Glass
options.description: Ethereal glass morphism with floating elements, aurora gradients, and depth
options.aside:
Ultra-modern, atmospheric, and immersive. Best for showing you're building the future, not just engineering for today.

• Deep navy/black with floating glass cards (backdrop-blur)
• Aurora gradients — cyan (#22d3ee) to violet (#a78bfa) to rose (#fb7185)
• Multiple depth layers with parallax scroll
• Soft glows and inner shadows
• Rounded everything — friendly, accessible, premium
• Fluid animations and micro-interactions

Projects appear as floating panes. Experience has depth stacking. Photo has soft double-exposure feel.

options.label: Neo-Tokyo Cyberpunk
options.description: High-voltage neon aesthetic with Japanese influences and glitch effects
options.aside:
Maximum impact for standing out in tech. Bold, aggressive, unapologetically you.

• Pure black (#000) with electric accents: neon pink (#ff006e), cyan (#00f5ff), electric yellow (#ffea00)
• Japanese typography accents (志梵 — your name in kanji concept)
• Glitch/distortion effects on hover and scroll
• Grid overlays, scanlines, digital noise texture
• Vertical text elements, asymmetric layouts
• Audio-visual feel (waveform visualizers, spectrum bars)

Photo treated with duotone neon effect. Sections separated by sharp diagonal cuts.

options.label: Swiss Brutalist
options.description: Maximalist minimalism with bold typography, raw structure, and no decoration
options.aside:
The ultimate 'show don't tell' approach. Your work speaks. No gradients, no shadows, no rounded corners.

• Pure white (#fff) or off-black (#1a1a1a) — no middle ground
• Helvetica Now or Neue Haas Grotesk — one typeface only
• Extreme scale contrast — 120px headlines next to 11px labels
• Grid-based everything — strict column alignment
• Single accent: signal red (#ff3300) or cobalt blue (#0044ff)
• Generous whitespace — let elements breathe
• Sharp rectangular crops, no border-radius anywhere

Your Tesla experience becomes bold typographic hierarchy. Projects are stark list entries. No photos — or photo as raw unmasked rectangle.
